default/32047.htm.text: Wendy: Welcome to Dr. Chaos's lab. Please observe proper precautions. If you do not, you may die.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: Sir, you are causing me considerable concern with your questions. Doctor Chaos and the clan hall are not usually objects of curiosity, except among dangerous people. Why are you asking these questions?
Wendy: This is Dr. Chaos's office. May I help you?
Wendy: Oh, it's you! Such a nice person! Do you have another question?
Wendy: Oh, it's you. See here, I'm not going to answer any of your questions. Please leave.
Wendy: But why is the Dwarf Guild looking for Dr. Chaos now? I don't think the Doctor wants to talk to the Dwarf Guild. Have a nice day!
Wendy: Oh, you've come back! It's nice to see you. May I help you with something?
Wendy: Oh, it's you again. Listen, I said I wasn't going to answer any more questions, and that's final!

links.text: "Don't be that way; I just want to talk."

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: If you're from the Dwarf Guild, Dr. Chaos doesn't want to talk to you. Good day!

links.text: "Never mind Dr. Chaos; I want to talk to you."

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: Those memories aren't clear to me... I do remember that once there were flowers all around this lab. A friend of mine walked with me. A large man petted me. I called him "Master."

links.text: Ask about the friend in more detail.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: I don't think I can tell you any more than I have right now. If you want to know more, please come back again; I may remember more later.
Wendy: I said I'd get physical if you did. Do you really want to fight?
Wendy: You have defeated the guardian and I must obey you. What do you want to know?

links.text: About Dr. Chaos' golem control method.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: There is a box around here containing several Starstones. If you bring it to me, perhaps I will be able to recall more of my past.
Wendy: Oh, you brought the Starstone! May I have it? It may help me recover my lost memories!

Wendy: I will try to remember... Oh, this is an old memory. A long time ago, when the lab began operation, I was in charge of transportation and management of materials. My friend Atlanta was in charge of controlling various golems. The Master's research concerned... um... I'm sorry, that's all I c…
Wendy: Dr. Chaos's office - how may I help you?

links.text: Tell her you came here to get the Starstone.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: Would you like to buy a Starstone for 3000 Adena?
Wendy: Would you like to ask me something else?
Wendy: Starstone? Why, yes, there are some Starstones in a small wooden box behind me. Take as many as you want.
Wendy: Did you find any Starstones? I don't know what you'll do with them, but I hope they help you.
Wendy: I already gave you a Starstone!

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-01.html.text: Wendy: Why have you come to see me?

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-07.html.text: Wendy: I think Atlanta is probably my friend. But I'm not sure. I have no proof.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-08.html.text: Wendy: That flower... May I see it, please?

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-11.html.text: Wendy: I... need some time... to think. While I think... I want you to reflect upon... about what you need to do... when you return... to the people who sent you.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-12.html.text: Wendy: You... came here before. I tried my best... to remember. I still can't remember many things, but... I think I can remember something. I remember the current state of affairs... I remember telling Atlanta about what was happening.

links.text: Ask about the current state of affairs.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-16.html.text: Wendy: Please ask Atlanta for more detailed information. She will probably know more about the Arrival of Eternal Spring and Pavel's last study.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-17.html.text: Wendy: I just felt a sensation as if something... or someone... was leaving the north research wing. Was that you?

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-20.html.text: Wendy: Dr. Chaos' records about that period are still on the bookshelf next to his lab. They are in a locked book that I cannot open. Perhaps the Dwarves of the north may know how. Please be careful. There might be a trap on the shelf.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-21.html.text: Wendy: I see you found the book... but I don't know how to open it. Take it to the Dwarves in the north. They may know.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-22.html.text: Wendy: I have been waiting for you, to give you the message Atlanta left.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-27.html.text: Wendy: This is the last message Atlanta left...

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-30.html.text: Wendy: I think he saw strength of will and deep wisdom in you. Now that I have this part of him, I have learned a few things from the information he gave. I will tell you now.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-34.html.text: Wendy: Please tell the Dwarf what I said. The danger here is past; you have resolved all of the problems. I am being operated by a Starstone, but once that Starstone disappears, I will begin to be deactivated. That process will take some time, but I am looking forward to it. I want to rest.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: This is the laboratory of Dr. Chaos. Sadly, he has not been in the office much lately. When he was here, however, he was a maker of golems.
Wendy: Dr. Chaos is a brilliant inventor who commanded the Horrifying Golem Army. He has also restored the Ruins of Pavel. He is a truly great man.
Wendy: Dr. Chaos's office. May I help you?

Wendy: Who, me? I'm, er, Wendy. I'm Dr. Chaos's secretary. I... hmm. I can't actually recall anything else about myself. I suppose nobody has ever asked. Why are you asking about me? Are you really, um, curious about me?
Wendy: Tee-hee! That's nice. Nobody was ever interested in me before. You seem nice. Feel free to come back anytime with, um, questions or anything.
Wendy: Hmph! I don't think so, mister. That's a pretty generic answer. You're not fooling anybody. Go on - get out! I'm not talking to you any more.

Wendy: You're from the Dwarf Guild? Certainly, Dr. Chaos is a Dwarf... but why is the Dwarf Guild suddenly interested in him? I don't believe he wants any contact with anyone from the Dwarf Guild. Have a nice day.
Wendy: Hello, Dr. Chaos's office! How may I help you?

links.text: I want to know how Dr. Chaos controlled his golems.
Where are you from, Wendy? How did you come to exist?

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: I'm sorry, but I can't tell you anything else without the Doctor's permission.
Wendy: Hmm. Well... if Dr. Chaos doesn't forbid it, I suppose I can answer your questions. How can I help you?

links.text: I want to know about the Golem Controller.
I want to know about the relationship between Dr. Chaos and Master Toma.
I want to know about the Horrifying Golem Army.
I want to know about what Wendy experienced when she woke up.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: Oh... you want to know about Dr. Chaos' golem control method?

links.text: "Actually, I'm more curious about how you came to exist."

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: Why are you asking me about this?

links.text: "I'm asking on behalf of the Dwarf Guild."

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: I'm sorry, but I'm not authorized to tell you where Dr. Chaos is. Have a nice day!

links.text: "You'd better answer, before I get physical about it."

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: I'm sorry, but I can't answer questions about the Golem Controller. May I help you in some other way?
Wendy: Where did I come from? Why, silly, Dr. Chaos made me! When I first opened my eyes, he called me Wendy, so that is my name.
Wendy: So you're asking on behalf of the Dwarf Guild? Dr. Chaos doesn't want anything to do with the Dwarf Guild. Be gone.
Wendy: Then I'll have to get violent with you. Think you can handle it?
Wendy: Hmm. I don't really know about their relationship, but... just between us, sometimes it seemed as if Dr. Chaos resented Master Toma. How else can I help you?
Wendy: It's funny you should ask. Sometimes I do have strange memories from a time before Dr. Chaos made me. Even at the very moment I was brought to life, I somehow already knew many things.
Wendy: I'm afraid I can't help you.
Wendy: Dr. Chaos created a large number of new golems, which he called the Horrifying Golem Army .

links.text: Ask about how the golems were made.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: Those memories aren't clear... I do remember that there were flowers all around this lab. I had a friend, and we walked together. A large man petted me. I called him "Master."
Wendy: Please wait. I'm very busy right now.
Wendy: The golems that Dr. Chaos constructed here were part of the Horrifying Golem Army. May I answer any other questions?
Wendy: You said you wanted to fight, so enough talk. Let's fight!

Wendy: I woke up. Dr. Chaos was standing next to me. He gave me my name, Wendy. I looked around for Master; I wanted him to pet me, but he was not there. My friend was gone... Master was gone. So I accepted Dr. Chaos as my new master.

links.text: Ask about anything else she remembers.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: I remember flowers... It was very cold around the lab, so very cold. There were no flowers then. Master said he wanted me to see the flowers, and he said he would dedicate himself to making something he called the "Weathermaster" . Then one day, as I walked around with my friend, it was sudd…

links.text: Ask her about anything else she remembers.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: The flowers... It was always very cold around the lab. So cold, and no flowers. Master said he wanted me to see flowers, and he said he would dedicate himself to making something he called the Weathermaster . Then one day, as I walked around here with my friend, suddenly there was a warm sun…
Wendy: I... don't remember anything. It was so long ago...

links.text: Insist that she try to remember.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: Master... Master was large. I definitely remember calling a large person "Master."
Wendy: Master... Master was large, so very large... I remember calling another large person "Master" in the past.
Wendy: I can't remember. I just can't... Let me think about it.
Wendy: My friend... My friend was gigantic, with a body made entirely of stone - like a walking boulder. He helped Master somehow...

Wendy: I don't know much about Dr. Chaos' methods of controlling his golems. But I do recall he said that electric waves are needed to control a golem. I think he has some kind of device that generated electric waves.
Wendy: There is a box somewhere around here containing several Starstones. If you bring it to me, perhaps I will be able to recall more of my past.
Wendy: My gigantic friend... He was the Doctor's research administrator. He was in charge of many golems that helped the doctor in his research. I do not know where he is now, but I miss him.
Wendy: Master Toma? I never met him, but... I heard Dr. Chaos mention him once while he was talking to himself.
Wendy: A Starstone? Why, yes, there are some Starstones in a wooden box behind me. Take as many as you want.
Wendy: Thank you. The Starstone is giving me the energy I need to recover my memories. Please come back later so we can talk more.
Wendy: The Starstone is an important material for us, too. I can't simply give it to you.

links.text: Ask her if there is a way to get it.

Q00114_ResurrectionOfAnOldManager/32047-.text: Wendy: It may be possible to give you one - for the right price. Does 3000 Adena seem reasonable?
Wendy: Very well; here are your Starstones.
Wendy: I'm afraid that if you do not have sufficient funds, I cannot give you any Starstones.
Wendy: As you wish...but do not expect to find any Starstones in the box like last time. I cleared it out.

links.text: "It's a golem made out of gigantic stones. Does that help you remember?"

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-03.html.text: Wendy: "At...lan...ta..." No, I don't remember anything about that. Old Pavel... research wing... no, I don't remember anything.

links.text: "Tell me about the Electric Wave Detector."

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-04.html.text: Wendy: I think it's the person or thing who control golems under Dr. Chaos' command. It was as large as my old friend...

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-05.html.text: Wendy: Perhaps I already mentioned this to you. I remember walking on a path surrounded by lots of flowers. My gigantic friend walked with me. I do not know what my friend could have had to do with this electric wave device, however.

links.text: Tell Wendy about the possibility that the friend is Atlanta.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-06.html.text: Wendy: Yes. Atlanta was probably my friend, but I can't recall for sure. Perhaps I would remember more if something jogged my memory, some kind of proof. Without it, I can't be sure.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-09.html.text: Wendy: This flower... The smell. I remember it. I remember... my friend. It's still so confusing. I can only recall one thing, and I don't know what it means: This flower was registered in experiment plan file N-45. Administrator Pavel, and... ... um...

links.text: Ask her if she is OK.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-10.html.text: Wendy: Yes, I'm fine, thank you. But I need more time to think. Let me think...

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-13.html.text: Wendy: All I know is that Dr. Chaos operated some kind of device. According to my memory, the device was meant to control the weather around Pavel. When the sleeping system awoke, its first act was to activate this device. I think perhaps the last mode in which it operated was N-45: Arrival of Eter…

links.text: Ask about the Arrival of Eternal Spring.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-14.html.text: Wendy: The Arrival of Eternal Spring was the last study conducted here. I do not know how it was possible, but for a while it was always spring here. But then an opposite reaction occurred, and it became the cold place it is now. I think Atlanta and I fell asleep at that time and were later revived…

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-15.html.text: Wendy: Please ask Atlanta for more detailed information. She will probably know more about the Arrival of Eternal Spring and Pavel's last study.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-18.html.text: Wendy: You made it in spite of all the guardians? I'm surprised. You must be very skilled. How can I help you?

links.text: Ask about what is going on the east wing.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-19.html.text: Wendy: The east wing? Oh, yes. You are probably are talking about the place where I was born. Dr. Chaos had his offices in the east wing. The last guardian was also resurrected there. My memory of that time is not clear, but Dr. Chaos' records are still on the bookshelf next to his lab. The record …

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-23.html.text: Wendy: Atlanta thought you would stop N-45, the Arrival of Eternal Spring. That study should never have been conducted. Dr. Chaos probably stumbled onto it by accident. He really only required the energy necessary to operate the Ultimate Golem Spartacus... he certainly did not need N-45.

links.text: Talk about cutting off the energy to the Gigantic Golem in the east wing.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-24.html.text: Wendy: The Gigantic Golem should have been deactivated by now. But it became just like the golems fashioned by the Dwarves... activated by crystals and the power of the Starstone. Thanks to Dr. Chaos's work, the power of the Gigantic Golems is greater than it was when the Dwarves cast him out.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-25.html.text: Wendy: After making the Gigantic Golem, Dr. Chaos became obsessed with its power. Perhaps this happened because the Doctor was exposed to the Flames of Pa'agrio for too long. It is said that they are the flames of the gods themselves; no mere mortal can remain unscathed after bathing in them. They …

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-26.html.text: Wendy: Very well. First, please hand me Atlanta's heart.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-28.html.text: A message from Atlanta [Wendy speaks in a deep voice which is obviously not hers.] My little friend... I thank you for your help. Thanks to you, I am now able to join my friends in a time and place far away, finally freed from my worries. When I look back, it all seems so strange... the great Spire…

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-29.html.text: A message from Atlanta Lastly, I thank you for preventing the disaster. I assume Doctor Pavel is also grateful to you. Doctor Chaos remains, but you will not need my power to deal with him. If adventurers such as yourselves combine your efforts, you will be strong enough to fight against even more …

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-31.html.text: Wendy: Listen closely, for this pertains to Dr. Chaos. From time to time, he comes here. If you attempt to speak with him, though, he will treat you as an enemy and dispatch a Gigantic Chaos Golem to rend the flesh from your bones. If you can defeat him here, it will certainly keep him from causing…

links.text: Ask about the Horrifying Golem Army.

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-32.html.text: Wendy: Do not concern yourselves about the Horrifying Golem Army. They cannot leave this place. Atlanta is gone now, so there is nothing and nobody to send electric waves to them. They cannot even receive Dr. Chaos' commands; they are merely broken machines, capable only of simple aggression. Now I…

links.text: "I think I have to go back to Yumi."

Q00120_PavelsLastResearch/32047-33.html.text: Wendy: I have no more to say to you. Please tell the Dwarf what I said. There is no more danger here; you have resolved all of the problems. I am being operated by a Starstone, but once that Starstone disappears, I will begin to be deactivated. I am looking forward to it... I want to rest, at long …
